title: Angle Type Explorer
description: An interactive MicroSim that allows students to classify angles as acute, right, obtuse, or straight by adjusting a slider from 0° to 180°.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Angles
learningObjectives: Classify an angle as acute, right, obtuse, or straight based on its degree measure
Identify the boundary measures of 90 and 180 degrees where an angle's classification changes
Predict how an angle's classification changes as the slider sweeps from 0 to 180 degrees
Estimate the degree measure of a drawn angle before verifying it with the slider readout
